instruction: Can you install the Telegram messaging app on my Ubuntu machine?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing Telegram using Ubuntu package manager. Evaluator checks if 'which telegram-desktop' command returns a valid path containing 'telegram' and not 'not found', confirming successful installation.
metadata.verification: Verified using existing check_include_exclude metric with vm_command_line getter. Telegram is available in Ubuntu repositories (as telegram-desktop), similar single-package installation as Spotify.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses 'which telegram-desktop' command to check installation status
Getter (get_vm_command_line) properly executes the command and returns stdout

When installed, 'which telegram-desktop' returns path like '/usr/bin/telegram-desktop' containing 'telegram'

Complete coverage: evaluator fully verifies the installation requirement
